TASK-012.title: Select first concept-root migration boundary
TASK-012.summary: Keep TASK-012 cancelled after stale audit code path reconciliation; TASK-021 owns active audit migration implementation.

goal.outcome: Maintainers have a durable, approved first concept-root migration boundary and staged compatibility plan instead of an unresolved open question.
acceptance: Drift-lens evidence is used to compare candidate first concepts such as session, state, roadmap, build, validation, audit, project, and agency.
Decision/planning evidence records the chosen first migration target or explicitly defers migration with owner, trigger, and rationale.
Compatibility constraints are listed, including public package behavior, barrels/exports, tests, and recent compatibility guarantees.
Resulting implementation task boundaries are created/refined only after the chosen first target is approved.
No source files are moved during this task.
The surface consumes generated graph/status/audit drift data from TASK-010 rather than duplicating file-structure truth.
Approved migration deltas are visually/report-wise separate from actionable drift.
Source paths and canonical diagram/KB refs are available for every displayed claim.
No new user-facing command is added unless existing UI/status surfaces cannot host the data safely.
Existing public package behavior and audit behavior remain compatible.
The surface consumes generated graph/status/audit drift data rather than duplicating file-structure truth.
Source paths and canonical refs are available for every displayed claim.
Existing public package behavior remains compatible.
non_goals: Do not create an umbrella task that only closes other tasks.
Do not change public package behavior.
Do not make generated UI output canonical truth.
Do not add a broad new product mode beyond the review surface.
verification: decision/planning validation for selected first migration boundary

delta.desired:
The accepted concept-root direction has a durable next-step decision/planning boundary.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Maintainers can review intended structure, current structure, approved migration deltas, and actionable file-structure drift through an existing human-visible CodeWiki surface.
Refinement: The accepted human-driven structure review surface has executable UI/status work queued.
delta.current:
The decision build asks which concept root should migrate first; no durable roadmap item owned that question after TASK-010 closed.
Refinement: TASK-010 exposed graph/audit data only; no human UI/report surface task remained open.
delta.closure:
Task closes when first migration target/order is approved or explicitly deferred with owner/trigger/rationale.
Refinement: Task closes when maintainers can inspect intended/current/delta/drift data in an existing CodeWiki human surface with source refs.

TASK-022.title: Migrate build, validation, and gateway concept roots
TASK-022.summary: Move compiler build, validation report/preflight, codewiki_build/codewiki_validation tools, and gateway transaction ownership into source-root build/validation/gateway concepts while preserving public behavior and proof policy.

goal.outcome: Build, validation, and gateway concepts have source-root ownership under src/build/**, src/validation/**, and src/gateway/**, with old layer-first owner paths removed or retained only as explicit temporary shims.
acceptance: Create src/build/** owner modules for build types, lifecycle helpers, decision-propagation helpers, build writer/use-case execution, and codewiki_build tool execution moved from src/domain/build/**, src/application/builds.ts, and src/application/tools/build.ts.

Create src/validation/** owner modules for validation types, validation report writing, validation preflight/risk policy, and codewiki_validation tool execution moved from src/domain/validation/**, validation-owned sections of src/application/builds.ts, and src/application/tools/validation.ts.
Create src/gateway/** owner modules for gateway transaction helpers moved from src/application/gateway/** when they are validation/gateway-owned rather than generic application plumbing.

Update adapters, schemas, graph/resume/task callers, tests, scripts, and package smoke to import build/validation/gateway behavior from src/build/**, src/validation/**, src/gateway/**, or stable public API paths, not old layer-first owner paths.

Preserve codewiki_build and codewiki_validation tool schema/result behavior; decision/planning/implementation build output shape; validation report/preflight semantics; task-close/publication content-proof policy; package loading; direct Node execution; and smoke/feature coverage.
Add or update TASK-specific tests proving old build/validation/gateway layer-first imports are gone or any temporary compatibility shims are explicit, scoped, and test-backed.

Update file-structure KB/diagram to mark the build/validation/gateway wave status and keep session, roadmap, state/graph/resume, project, knowledge, GC, and change roots gated until TASK-022 task-close evidence exists.
non_goals: Do not migrate session, roadmap, state/graph/resume, project, knowledge, GC, change, adapters, UI, or skills in this task.
Do not change public tool schemas, validation profile names, package metadata, package entrypoints, build JSON schema, validation JSON schema, or product behavior.
Do not remove source paths outside the build/validation/gateway boundary except import updates required by this migration.

delta.desired: Build, validation, and gateway concepts have source-root ownership under src/build/**, src/validation/**, and src/gateway/** with public behavior preserved.
delta.current: Build and validation/gateway code remain split across src/domain/build/**, src/domain/validation/**, src/application/builds.ts, src/application/tools/build.ts, src/application/tools/validation.ts, and src/application/gateway/**.
delta.closure: Implementation build and validation prove build/validation/gateway migration, compatibility-preserving imports, updated tests/KB/diagram, and no non-wave source migration.

SPRINT-001.title: CodeWiki vNext decision and graph workflow
SPRINT-001.outcome: Deliver the vNext operating model in bounded compatibility-safe increments, now prioritizing agent-owned session-boundary automation and workflow-efficiency friction reduction before decision_build implementation.
gates: Prioritize TASK-005 session-boundary automation/workflow-friction work before TASK-001 decision_build implementation until this accepted priority is resolved.
Keep current CodeWiki public behavior frozen except critical blocker fixes until vNext replacement flows validate.
Do not remove compatibility feedback/documentation/build/tool primitives before deprecation tests pass.
Each task must produce implementation_build and fresh validation evidence before close.

SPRINT-002.outcome: Prevent accepted decisions from drifting by enforcing decision-to-roadmap propagation and by giving the file-structure decision durable follow-up work.
gates: TASK-011 must land before future planning builds can be trusted to enforce complete decision propagation.
